players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
players.status: On 60-Day IL — Rehabbing (FCL Braves → Triple-A Gwinnett)

current_injury.mechanism: Hamstring: strained running to first base. Fibula: non-displaced fracture in Spring Training.
current_injury.details: Grade 1 left hamstring strain placed on 10-day IL June 10, 2025. FCL rehab since July 2025. Grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph). Went 0-for-3 with walk and 5 RBIs. Only DH — NOT cleared for outfield or live baserunning. Left fibula non-displaced fracture suffered March 3, 2026 in Spring Training. Transferred to Gwinnett July 17 for rehab. Nearing possible return on upcoming Braves homestand per MLB.com.

rehab_timeline.expected_return: Nearing possible return on upcoming Braves homestand

players.manager_quote: "He's probably as strong as he's ever been... When we turn him loose, we want him to be ready to go." — Walt Weiss
players.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 torn ACL. Rehab Gate watch critical: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation. Guardian Ha-Seong Kim also transferred to Gwinnett. MLB.com reports Acuña nearing possible return on Braves homestand.

latest_update.event: Acuña nearing possible return on upcoming Braves homestand. Grand slam in 3rd FCL rehab game (423 ft, 112.8 mph). Transferred to Gwinnett July 17. Cutting drills NOT cleared.

players.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.mechanism: Back stiffness not from specific incident. Wrist soreness resolved. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness (~25 lbs loss, 175→150 lbs). Toe fracture lingered but managed play-through.
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games for back stiffness. NOT expected on IL. 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15). Weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs. Manager Roberts opted non-IL playthrough approach for toe fracture because 'four days off vs 14 or 15 makes much difference'.
current_injury.weight_loss: ~25 lbs during late July 2025 viral illness

rehab_timeline.viral_care: New medication; full workout; weight stabilizing; turned a corner per Roberts

players.manager_quote: "He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot — we're just managing day-to-day." — Dave Roberts
players.notes: Most tumultuous recent stretch in memory. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected. 7-game hit streak confirms full recovery. Lineup: Freeman at 2nd, Betts at 3rd, Tucker at 4th, Ohtani at 1st.

latest_update.event: Back stiffness day-to-day; out 3+ games. 7-game hit streak. No IL expected.

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.status: Active & Healthy; Chronic Ankle Managed with Load Management

types: Chronic left ankle (managed via load management)
current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger: neck → right shoulder vs. Reds. Chronic ankle: prior sprains managed via load management. March 2025 rib/scar tissue resolved quickly during BP for Tokyo opener.
current_injury.details: No acute injury preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle managed with load management and treatment. Out Wed vs Reds with stinger; returned Friday with no lingering effects.
current_injury.management: Load management with rest days; occasional flare-ups monitored

recent_form.notable_milestone: 2024 WS MVP: Walk-Off Grand Slam, .280/.355/.565, 9 HR, 36 RBI, 25 SB
recent_form.2025: 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate, MLB leader in softball grounds

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups

injury_history.return_status: Returned; played through postseason, WS MVP

players.manager_quote: "He feels a lot better. There's still some kind of lingering effects, but nothing compromising... I feel confident that he can get through it and won't have any setbacks."
players.notes: Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require ongoing monitoring. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS legend despite injuries. Freeman is the most durable of the three tracked NL players.

latest_update.event: Out vs. Reds Wednesday with neck stinger. Returned Friday with no lingering effects. Currently playing with chronic ankle managed via load management.
